content: Root cause: The bug was caused by the NameNode (NN) incorrectly initiating a Remote Procedure Call (RPC) to itself to retrieve trash configuration defaults. This misuse of RPC led to potential issues where the system could behave incorrectly regarding the trash handling functionality if the server-side configuration was not available or could not be fetched. The fix ensures that the NR does not RPC to itself and instead properly handles the default trash configuration without unnecessary self-references, thus improving the reliability and correctness of trash management in Hadoop.
